sara (compliance): Quick check — we have the staging cutover smoke window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final owners for KMS key rotation doc and auditlog backfill. Who's on point?

jake (infra): I can own KMS rotation runbook. Will verify HSM attestation steps with @tom. PR INT-3987 has the playbook draft.

lina (platform): I'll take auditlog backfill orchestration. ETA to produce backfill plan by EOD today. Ticket BACKFILL-22

tom (runtime): @jake can you confirm whether we can do attestation without rekeying? last run required staged certs.

jake (infra): Good catch. We can do attestation-only if the HSM supports proof-of-possession. I'll validate with HSM vendor tonight and post result.

sara (compliance): If attestation-only works, compliance still needs evidence: signed attestation blob + auditlog of the rotation check. Can you add steps to PR INT-3987 to gather both?

jake (infra): Yep. I'll add a snippet. e.g.
```
# collect attestation
kubectl logs -n keystore keystore-0 | grep attestation > /tmp/attest.log
# push to secure bucket
gsutil cp /tmp/attest.log gs://redwood-compliance/staging/attest-
```

tom (runtime): For runtime, we need to ensure KV cache flush before cutover to avoid stale tokens. I'll open PR runtime#467 and add a pre-cutover job.

lina (platform): Backfill plan depends on auditlog ingestion gap window. @audit-bot can you run a quick count of missing events for last 24h in staging? :pray:

audit-bot: staging-auditgap-check: missing_events=0; last_event_ts=5050000020

lina (platform): nice, zero gaps. I'll still include an incremental backfill step in case prod differs.

sara (compliance): Ownership recap — @jake owns KMS rotation playbook + attestation evidence, @lina owns auditlog backfill plan, @tom adds runtime pre-cutover job. Please drop final PR links here when ready. Cutover window 09:00-09:30 PT tomorrow. :calendar:

jake (infra): dropping PR INT-3987 link when updated.

lina (platform): BACKFILL-22 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BACKFILL-22

tom (runtime): runtime#467 opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/467

sara (compliance): Great. Quick ask — can we have a 30-min dry-run today 16:30 PT? small checklist: playbook review, smoke run on staging, verify evidence artifacts exist.

jake (infra): 16:30 works for me.

lina (platform): I'm in.

tom (runtime): in. See you then.

sara (compliance): Awesome. I'll send calendar invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:
